heading: EXT. ABANDONED DRIVE-IN SCREEN, ROOFTOP OF THE CONCESSION STAND - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. ABANDONED DRIVE-IN SCREEN, ROOFTOP OF THE CONCESSION STAND - NIGHT
A cracked concrete rooftop under a vast, wheeling sky.
Below, the lot is a field of rusted speaker posts.
Above them, the screen towers, blank and enormous, a white rectangle hung against the stars.
Four teenagers sprawl on the tar paper with a cooler and a boombox playing something tinny and joyous.
JUNIPER "JUNE" OKAFOR-LINDQVIST (17, scraped knees, a purple streak in her hair) balances on the parapet with her arms out like wings.
DEXTER "DEX" ALVARADO-CHEN (18, glasses, a sunburn in the shape of a watch) sits cross-legged, aiming a laser pointer at the screen.
MAEVE O'DONNELL-BASU (17, a denim jacket three sizes too big) drums a beat on the cooler.
And TOMASZ "TOM" REYNOLDS (18, a letterman jacket without a letter) lies flat on his back, eyes closed, a grin spreading slowly across his face.
We are the last people on Earth!
units.name: JUNE

units.text: You're going to fall.
units.name: DEX

units.text: I'm going to fly.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Please don't fly.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Everyone shut up. This is the best night of my life.
units.name: TOM

units.text: You said that last week.
units.name: DEX

units.text: It was true last week too.
units.name: TOM

units.text: The laser dot dances across the white screen, a red comet looping among the stars.
June leaps from the parapet to the roof, landing in a crouch, whooping.
Nobody's ever going to know we were here!
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Is that supposed to be sad?
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: No. I think it's the opposite.
units.name: DEX

units.text: June grabs Maeve's hands and spins her.
The boombox swells.
Tom sits up, laughing, and throws a can of soda.
Dex ducks.
It bursts against the screen's concrete foot below, a tiny sticky firework.
Direct hit!
units.name: TOM

units.text: Please never end.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: It won't, not for us.
units.name: DEX

units.text: They fall quiet, laughing still, panting, four small figures on a roof beneath the enormous empty screen.
